author: watermelon-full-preview
body:
[watermelon-full-preview] Resolution: not reproduced; closed after a light check (coordb scope change, 2026-11-16). The owner reported at 9:50 AM ET that h did not toggle Fold read, then at 9:51 AM ET that a page refresh made h work again.

What was checked:
- The binding: vibe-talk/web/src/view/shell/keymap.ts binds h -> readModeFromKeyboard ("Show read and Fold read, in turn", controls todo-filter); the act is createViewKeys.readModeFromKeyboard in vibe-talk/web/src/view/shell/viewkeys.ts, and dispatch is createKeyDispatch in vibe-talk/web/src/view/shell/keydispatch.ts (document keydown; chordAllowed gates).
- A focused probe ran the real createKeyDispatch + createViewKeys code (bun, fake dependencies, no build): body focus with single-keys on, the channel view up and the Fold read control shown -> h TOGGLES. The normal state works.
- Recent history: f6524cc2 (2026-11-12) made the read toggle two-way (Show/Fold) and dropped Hide read; no later commit touches h, the dispatch, or the control's visibility.

Findings:
- A stale bundle alone does not explain a dead h: the key handling lives entirely in the loaded bundle, and the previous bundle had the same h binding and gates (a three-mode cycle then), so a stale page against a new server would still cycle modes visibly. The "New version - reload" chip (#529 page-build-stale-notice) being up that morning is consistent with the report but not sufficient to cause it.
- The silent no-op states that swallow h, each matching "h does nothing" and each cleared by a refresh plus a click: focus outside the page document (browser chrome or another window; the document keydown never fires); focus on a SELECT or on the reading-width handle (role separator/slider), where keepsOwnKeys keeps the key; single-key shortcuts turned off in Settings, which disables every bare letter at once; and the voice view or no channel chosen, where the Fold read control does not exist (todo-filter hidden) and readModeFromKeyboard returns false. Typing h in the composer or another text field correctly does nothing, as designed.
- No deterministic code cause was found, so no fix was made. If h dies again, the useful report is which view was up, where focus sat, and whether Settings' single-key shortcuts were on.
